description: DOWNLOAD attachments of an epic, feature, user story or defect from SimplifyQA to a local folder — fetched from SimplifyQA with the user's login (not copied from a local file). Pass `entityType` + `itemId` (EP-69, FT-269, US-1330, DE-75). If the item has ONE attachment it is downloaded; if it has SEVERAL and you pass no choice, the tool LISTS them (name, size, id) — show that list to the user and call again with `attachments` (names or ids, one or several) or `all:true`. `outDir` is the folder to save into (default "./exports"; created if missing). The answer gives each saved path, file name and size and says whether the size matches what SimplifyQA reports; an existing file is never overwritten (a " (1)" is added).

all.description: true = download every attachment of the item.

attachments.description: Which attachments: file names or ids (one or several). Omit to be shown the list when there is more than one.

entityType.description: Which backlog item the attachment belongs to.

itemId.description: Item id or business key (EP-69, FT-269, US-1330, DE-75).

name: attachment_download
title: Download an attachment of an epic, feature, user story or defect (SimplifyQA)
